Strategy: Hard scaled narrow awkward-band avoidance. Exact fits score highest; residuals between half the item and the full item lose a penalty of twice the item, while tighter and roomier residuals rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit falls in that narrow awkward band while a looser bin can hold another item. It may help by never leaving the most awkward leftovers, but may fail if it overuses roomy bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) - 2 * item if r - item > item / 2 and r - item <= item else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Hard scaled narrow awkward-band avoidance: penalize residual in (item/2, item] by 2*item, exact fit highest.
